posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
What exactly do you want different? You can change the location of the text window, the level of transparency, and maybe a few other things that I'm not thinking of.

posts.body:
you can do show picture + position x/y  and than message.
Galv_MessageBackground is for MV, but I dont know if it is ported to MZ though.

as it is tied to the message window so it would erase itself if the message box is closed.
